goal_features.statement: Professional computing coursework supports career development. The department states that it stopped approving Computer Sciences CPT as of 2026-08-24; internships or work authorization are not guaranteed.

internship_policy.notes.1: The department states that it stopped approving Computer Sciences CPT on 2026-08-24. Internship encouragement and catalog cooperative-education credits do not establish present CPT approval or guaranteed work authorization.

fact_summary: The professional CS program requires 30 credits and supports career development. The department explicitly states that Computer Sciences CPT approvals stopped; older internship examples must not be read as current approval.
